build_padding_layer_zero: build a zero padding layer using build_padding_layer with type zero and padding config
build_padding_layer_reflect: build a reflection padding layer using build_padding_layer with type reflect and padding config
build_padding_layer_replicate: build a replication padding layer using build_padding_layer with type replicate and padding config
build_padding_layer_from_class: build a padding layer by passing a class directly as the type in the config dict
review_padding_registry: review the MODELS registry to see which padding types are registered including zero reflect and replicate
